text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!
Today, Tracen Academy is filled with the echoes of high-pitched screaming. The cause for all this? Fuji Kiseki.
A long, long line winds around the courtyard like tangled yarn.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll savor every bite of this chocolate you so kindly made for me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text: I-I hope you like it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member
text_block_list.text: Okay! Next in line, please!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text: I-I always go to your races, Fuji! I'm cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll keep doing my best to make it worth it for you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text: O-ooh!
choice_data_list: (It must be tough being this popular.)

text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki greets each of her fans with a sincere smile and charming politeness—the line never seems to get any shorter.
At night…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Good evening, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness you're still here! I wanted to come see you at lunch, but I was so busy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I just thought you might've been expecting something from me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Keep this a secret from everyone, okay? Happy Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …Huh? Where'd it go?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I made some chocolate just for you, but it's gone!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Could I have misplaced it at lunch? But no, I still had it just a moment ago…
Fuji Kiseki mutters to herself as she frantically turns all her pockets out, but the chocolate in question is nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh no, I must've lost it! I'm so sorry…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No, it's n—wait! Can you check your pockets too?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Please? Can you just check your right pocket real quick?
There's no way… I reach into my pocket… and pull out a beautifully wrapped chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I hope you didn't think that was too sappy. It's not Valentine's Day every day, so I wanted to surprise you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No. Thank you. I look forward to our continued collaboration.
Fuji Kiseki and I spend an unforgettable Valentine's Day together.
Fuji Kiseki takes out a gorgeous bouquet of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome! Also… I have a request.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This might sound strange, but may I have one of these flowers?
I'm not sure why she wants one, but I see no reason to refuse.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm just so hungry.
She brings the bouquet to her lips…
And eats a small rose.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmm, that was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I love roses. The thorns can be painful to eat sometimes, but that only adds to the texture.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My favorite are red roses. Their sweet fruitiness makes them extra tasty.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What do you say? Want to try a bite?
She hands me the bouquet, and I hold it dumbly, unsure what to do.
Then, I notice the sweet smell of caramel.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, have you finally noticed? They're actually made of sugar!
It's impossible to tell they're fake without getting a real close look them. Their colors and shapes look just like the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: They're pretty well made if I do say so myself. I practiced making them just for today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wanted to give you a memorable present. How'd I do?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I'll call it a success, then!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Roses are red, violets are blue, sugar is sweet, but not as sweet as you."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Here's to more sweet days together, my dearest Trainer.
Fuji Kiseki and I spend an unforgettable Valentine's Day together.
